words.example_en: Children are very active and like to run and jump.
words.example_uz: Bolalar juda faol va yugurish va sakrashni yoqtiradi.

words.example_en: He believes he is a smart boy.
words.example_uz: U aqlli bola ekanligiga ishonadi.

words.example_en: Fresh air is a good reason to live in a clean environment.
words.example_uz: Toza havo obod atrof-muhitda yashashga yaxshi sabab.

words.example_en: The forest seems to be burning.
words.example_uz: Oʻrmon yonayotgandek koʻrinadi.

words.example_en: The old bridge was built by humans a long time ago.
words.example_uz: Eski koʻprik uzoq vaqt avval insonlar tomonidan qurilgan.

words.example_en: Some people in North America like to hunt.
words.example_uz: Janubiy Amerikadagi baʼzi odamlar ovlashni yoqtiradi.

words.example_en: Both paths take you to the gate of the park.
words.example_uz: Ikkala yoʻlaklar ham sizni bogʻning darvozasiga olib boradi.

words.example_en: The gentleman stands in a safe place away from the subway.
words.example_uz: Kishi metrodan xavfsiz joyda turibdi.

words.example_en: The new restaurant has delicious food and great service.
words.example_uz: Yangi restoranning taomlari mazali va xizmati juda ajoyib.

words.example_en: Africa is a popular place to see wild animals.
words.example_uz: Afrika yovvoyi hayvonlarni koʻrish uchun eng mashhur joy.

words.example_en: The people living in this area are very poor.
words.example_uz: Bu hududda yashaydigan odamlar juda kambagʻal.

words.example_en: It is your choice. Do you want to go north or south?
words.example_uz: Bu sizning tanlovingiz. Siz shimolga borishni xohlaysizmi yoki janubgami?

words.example_en: She enters through the front gate.
words.example_uz: U old darvozadan kiradi.

words.example_en: The king is the most important piece in the game.
words.example_uz: Shoh - oʻyinning eng muhim qismi.

words.example_en: She lies in the grass and looks up at the sky.
words.example_uz: U maysada yotib, osmonga qaraydi.

words.example_en: The woman is mad because someone hit her car.
words.example_uz: Ayol dargʻazab, chunki kimdir uning mashinasini urib yuborgan.

words.example_en: She likes to take pictures of nature.
words.example_uz: U tabiatni suratga olishni yaxshi koʻradi.

words.example_en: The umbrella protects the people from the hot sun.
words.example_uz: Soyabon odamlarni issiq quyoshning harorati himoya qiladi.

words.example_en: The shy boy surprised everyone by shouting.
words.example_uz: Uyatchan bola baqirib, barchani hayratda qoldirdi.

words.example_en: People usually shake hands when they introduce themselves.
words.example_uz: Odamlar, odatda, oʻzlarini tanishtirganda qoʻl siqishadilar.
